about: Ammonia (NH₃) is a toxic, pungent gas supplied as a liquefied gas in cylinders. Industrially it is used as a refrigerant (R717) in cold storage and ice plants, in metal treatment such as nitriding, in water and effluent treatment and as a chemical raw material.
Ammonia is corrosive and toxic if inhaled. Only trained staff should handle it, with suitable PPE, leak detection and ventilation. Ask us for the Safety Data Sheet before your first order.

faq.question: Is ammonia gas dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. Ammonia is toxic and corrosive. Use it only with proper PPE, ventilation and trained staff, and request the Safety Data Sheet before use.
